items: Apache License 2.0 legal terms retained as non-research metadata.
Minimal simulator testing whether representation-revising agent recovers better after world shift than parameter-only learner.
v0 is not an AGI simulator or proof of full framework; it isolates representation-evolution behavior.
README formal surface: environment y=a*v*(1+z); state-only baseline y_hat=theta*v; REE candidate representations h0=a*v, h1=a*v+b*v*z, h2=a*v+phi(v,z).

README protocol: shift z from fixed to varying, trigger sleep after persistent torsion, generate candidates, evaluate on purported holdout with complexity control, commit only with significant generalization improvement, compare post-shift error/recovery/innovation/false mutations/complexity/compute.
REE is described as changing representation dimensionality/causal structure rather than only coefficients.
REE predicted to have lower post-shift error, faster recovery and sparse accepted representation changes.
If predicted pattern holds, source says controlled/testable representation change is supported.
Version 0 explicitly does not establish the full CTRE framework.

env.py implements velocity/context state, phase switch at change_point, phase-0 context=1 and target=2*v, phase-1 context~Uniform(.5,2.5) and target=v*context; observation exposes velocity/context/target/phase and reward is negative absolute prediction error.
hypothesis.py implements linear, interaction and stochastic augment transforms plus null/interaction/augment candidate generation with complexity bookkeeping.
StateOnlyAgent has fixed [velocity,context] representation, two weights, online gradient-style updates, recent-error reporting and fixed complexity=2.

REEAgent starts with [1,v], can use [1,v,v*context] or augment features, updates weights online, triggers sleep on recent mean absolute error, scores null by negative MAE and interaction by residual correlation, returns scored tuples, and can internally commit one representation mutation with weight resizing/logging.
Offline evaluator is intended to distinguish fixed-interface explanation from representation-improving candidates with complexity control.

OfflineEvaluator defines evidence fields, chronological split, least-squares fitting, [1,v] and [1,v,v*context] features, validation-data model fitting/scoring, complexity-adjusted improvement and >.01 pass criterion.
run.py implements pretraining, 5000-step state/REE runs, optional offline-evaluation branch, post-shift/recovery/innovation metrics, seeded sequential experiment setup and console reporting.
Executable success criteria assert REE post-shift error < state baseline and REE recovery time <= state baseline.
